record.oneLiner: Klaviyo provides a broad REST API for marketing automation, email, and SMS, authenticated via private API keys or OAuth, with self-serve free developer access and an official MCP server.
record.verdictReason: Klaviyo has a comprehensive, well-documented REST API with self-serve credentials and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

evidence.quote:
Private key authentication for /api endpoints is performed by setting the following request header:

Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key

If you are a tech partner integrating with Klaviyo, we recommend using OAuth to authenticate your app. OAuth offers multiple benefits over a private key integration, including security, usability, and improved rate limits. Check out our guide on setting up OAuth .
Quickstart New Klaviyo developers: Check out our Get started with Klaviyo series to set up an account, obtain API credentials, and authenticate.
Every endpoint in the Klaviyo REST API, with its authentication, parameters, request and response bodies, and an example request.

The Klaviyo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server seamlessly integrates with Klaviyo’s APIs, enabling AI clients to interact with your Klaviyo data. This page introduces the MCP server and what you can do with it.
